_README: Single source of truth for the contact details generators emit onto pages.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the phone number was hardcoded in 16 places across two
generators in two languages. A transposed number reached production and stayed
live for three months, and the audit found 115 anchors that display one number
while dialling the other. Every generator emitted the 917 line and none emitted
the 718 line, so regenerating any page family would have silently reverted the
DECISION PENDING: which line is the public brokerage number is a BROKER
decision that has not been made. The values below are exactly what the
generators emitted before this file existed — changing them here changes what
every generated page emits, which is the point. Do not change them casually.
After changing phone_display or phone_tel, the two must stay consistent with
each other, and scripts/dgp/test_phone_consistency.py enforces that no page
displays one number while dialling another.
